name: Joseph Reed
source:
Joseph is a well-known fiction writer and Lauren's neighbor.

Sweet and shy, Joseph is used to living alone. For him, it's easier to concentrate on his work without having people around to judge his decisions. However, he seems to enjoy Lauren's company better than the silence of loneliness.
He has been helping her since the day she moved to the city and from that day on his own life has been changed.

Joseph loves to take walks at night, pet his dog and drink a lot of coffee.
